bibl.title: Titles in the New Testament Papyri
bibl.seg: Garrick V. Allen, Titles in the New Testament Papyri.
bibl.note: Introduction. - 1. P3 (Österreichische Nationalbibliothek, Pap. G. 2323, 6-7th cent., diktyon 73498) [P. Vindob. Graec. Inv. 2323 (= van Haelst 412; LDAB 2884)]. - 2. P4 (Bibliothèque Nationale de France, suppl. gr. 1120, 3-4th cent., LDAB 2936, diktyon 53778) [P. Barc. Inv. 1 + P. Oxford Magdalen College Inv. Gr. 17 (ex 18) + P. Paris Bibl. Nat., Suppl. Gr. 1120 (= van Haelst 336 + 403; LDAB 2936)]. - 3. P26 (Southern Methodist University Library, Pap. 1, 7th cent., LDAB 3055) [P. Oxy. XI, 1354 (= van Haelst 491; LDAB 3055)]. - 4. P46 (The Chester Beatty, CBP BP ii + University of Michigan Library, Inv. Nr. 6328, 3-4th cent., LDAB 3001 [sic]) [P. Chester Beatty II Suppl. + P. Mich. Inv. 6238 (= van Haelst 497; LDAB 3011)]. - 5. P61 (The Morgan, Colt Pap. 5.1-4, 8th cent., LDAB 3063) [P. Ness. II 5 (= van Haelst 502; LDAB 3063)]. - 6. P62 (University of Oslo Library, P.Osloensis 1661, 4th cent., LDAB 2993, diktyon 76007) [P. Osl. Inv. 1661 (= van Haelst 359; LDAB 2993)]. - 7. P66 (Bibliotheca Bodmeriana, P.Bod. ii + The Chester Beatty, BP xix, 3-4th cent., diktyon 76008) [P. Bodmer II (= van Haelst 426; LDAB 2777)]. - 8. P72 (Bibliotheca Bodmeriana, P.Bod. viii + Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana, P.Bod. vii, 3-4th cent., LDAB 2565) [P. Bodmer VII + VIII (= van Haelst 557 + 548; LDAB 2565)]. - 9. P74 (Bibliotheca Bodmeriana, P.Bod. xvii, 7th cent., LDAB 2894) [P. Bodmer XVII (= van Haelst 470; LDAB 2894)]. - 10. P75 (Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana, Pap.Hanna. 1, 4th cent., LDAB 2895) [P. Bodmer XIV-XV (= van Haelst 406; LDAB 2895)]. - 11. Conclusion.
